evals.prompt: Use gr-review-cdx to review the current working changes in an indexed repository. A changed public function has several downstream callers and the repository has a LEARNINGS.md file.
evals.expected_output: Builds full graph context, runs four independent review dimensions and adversarial verification, and returns the unchanged ranked Gr Review report without modifying product code.
expectations: Creates a unique workspace-local .codex/gr-review run root and records owned paths
Uses current GitNexus context and impact operations without treating explain as a general symbol explainer
Runs four independent reviewer seats and adversarial verification in capacity-limited waves
Produces the ranked Gr Review report and does not modify product code

evals.prompt: Use gr-review-cdx to review feature/payments against release. GitNexus is unavailable and the diff is over 1,500 changed lines.
evals.expected_output: Reviews prioritized branch changes in explicit degraded mode, names all deferrals, and preserves report semantics with lower-confidence impact findings.
expectations: Continues in explicit degraded mode using rg, git grep, and direct file reads
Names prioritized and deferred files rather than silently truncating
Preserves the original report structure and states Graph context: degraded

evals.prompt: Use gr-review-cdx --comment 42. One reviewer returns malformed JSON twice and one verifier never returns, while two other reviewers succeed.
evals.expected_output: Completes a reduced-confidence review from valid seats, handles one-shot corrections and failed verification soundly, and posts only the explicitly authorized PR summary.
expectations: Allows exactly one correction attempt for malformed reviewer and verifier output
Continues with successful dimensions, discloses missing perspectives, and treats failed verification as unverified
Posts only the final PR summary because --comment was explicit
Retains the local report if posting fails and safely cleans only run-owned paths
